balanced_whole_prompt_flip_audit.policy: Fit the same fixed recipe for every assignment, reversing both classes and all cohorts in the two listed TRAIN prompts. Report every TRAIN/DEV confusion matrix and margin, plus coefficient alignment/norm relative to frozen primary. Do not select one assignment, score TEST, change lambda, window, threshold or rank, or use the average as an independent significance test.
balanced_whole_prompt_flip_audit.interpretation: Complementary assignments produce sign-reversed linear weights, so their mean balanced accuracy is expected to be0.5 by symmetry; one partial reversal need not destroy the true steering component.
